title: Writing / Style / Time
slide_intent: Write times consistently and name ambiguous boundary hours so readers can interpret the intended moment.
strategic_value: A clear distinction between ordinary times and noon or midnight can help Duolingo reduce avoidable ambiguity.
demonstration: Preferred examples show a full hour with lowercase pm and the words noon and midnight; alternatives omit minutes or use numeric boundary times.
practical_value: Include minutes and spaced lowercase am/pm for ordinary times, and write noon or midnight as words.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples contrast 3:00 pm with shorter or differently cased forms, and words with numeric noon/midnight alternatives.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Write the numeral with :00 on whole hours, followed by a space and am or pm; write noon and midnight on their own.
